name: Herbarium
line: A botanical archive: every section is a herbarium sheet with its museum label in the lower right (on the hero the headline is the label and the search a ruled line on it); the sheets slide up and settle over one another as you scroll, and two pressed fronds drawn to one scale show 100 to 120 against 4 to 5 lung cancers per 1,000.
notes: Castoro and Karla are Latin-only on Google Fonts: the RU and ZH pages would need other faces. Castoro has one weight plus its italic. The fronds are an inline SVG drawn for this page, with a ruler in cases per 1,000 (the outlined tip is the 100 to 120 range). The one archival-red stamp reads EpiDetective · Lyon · France. Stacking needs JavaScript; without it the sheets simply follow one another, and with reduced motion they still stack but do not scale or dim. Tall sheets (phones) scroll fully before they stick.
